Messages.Author: LivesByProxy
Messages.Body:
Does the superior  of Diabolic Lure burn the pool always after the block? Or is it only when the inferior  turns the blocked vamp infernal?

Diabolic Lure
Reaction
Reduce a bleed against you by 1.
Requires an infernal vampire. Only usable when this vampire successfully blocks. Put 4 pact counters on the acting minion. If the number of pact counters equals or exceeds his or her capacity or cost, burn them to make him or her infernal.
As above, and the acting minion's controller burns 1 pool.

Gangrel. Noddist. Camarilla. Once each turn, LivesByProxy may burn 1 blood to lose Protean  until the end of the turn and gain your choice of superior Auspex , Obfuscate , or Potence  for the current action.
